column2: aptus Philippines brief target 2, file 2 of 3 — Philippine tax rates
EMPTY, AND THE EMPTINESS IS THE FINDING. Zero data rows.
the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 Philippines localisation deliverable (88520ff2932b479090ed3b7b116b2e91), all 127 topics, 125 with a body. Every table on those pages was read.

SAP's published "Tax Codes for VAT" table for the Philippines carries Tax Code, Description, Accounting Key and Tax Type. It carries NO rate column and NO valid-from column. Several descriptions contain a percentage in prose ("Output VAT 12%-Goods"); a rate was NOT extracted from that text, because reading a number out of a description is inference, not publication.

the rate and valid-from live in the "Time Dependent Tax Rates" sheet of the Best Practices workbook 2608_Pre-configured_Tax_Codes_EN_PH.xlsx — the Philippine counterpart of the ..._EN_MY.xlsx file WS11 read. That workbook is not in the repository and the Best Practices content library requires a signed-in SAP session, which this run did not have.

SAP DOES publish rates for Philippine WITHHOLDING tax codes, and those are in withholding-tax-codes-ph.tsv beside this file. They are not in this file because withholding tax codes are a different code space from the VAT tax codes in tax-codes-ph.tsv, and putting them here would create joins that do not exist.
every tax_code in the rates file resolves against the codes file — vacuously satisfied: 0 rows. "count of rates SAP publishes with no percentage" — 0, because 0 rates are published on the pages read.
a blank is a blank. This file is empty because SAP publishes nothing here anonymously, not because nobody looked.
